correctness.rationale: Both directions are proved for all m,n>=2. Domination and connectivity translate to shore saturation and a connected bipartite incidence graph. Any cycle or leaf on the unsaturated shore violates inclusion-minimality; every classified tree is minimal. Matrix-tree determinant supplies the exact Stirling count. A direct exhaustive implementation checked 1,435,460 subsets and all 7,406 minimal solutions on twelve boards. Finite tests alone are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A full two-parameter classification and precise cardinality polynomial for a classical line-graph family, not a routine restatement of its already known connected-domination minimum. The sharp upper inclusion-minimal size n+m-2 and arbitrarily long holes 2m-1 through n-1 for n>=2m address natural extremal and enumeration questions. All-connected-set tables and general enumeration algorithms do not supply this size spectrum.
